reason: H0 omits the required final h2o_qpack_header_stats_t pointer when calling h2o_qpack_flatten_request, so S1+H0 has a material API-call gap. However, the S0 declaration already required that same final stats parameter; this commit only renames it to stats_updated and changes reset behavior to accumulation. Therefore the harness incompatibility is historical and was not introduced or materially aggravated by this commit.
evidence: H0 calls h2o_qpack_flatten_request(..., headers.entries, headers.size, h2o_iovec_init(NULL, 0)) with no statistics argument.
The S0 declaration already ends with h2o_iovec_t datagram_flow_id, h2o_qpack_header_stats_t *stats.
The S1 declaration preserves the same parameter position and type, renaming only *stats to *stats_updated.
S1 removes *stats = (h2o_qpack_header_stats_t){0} from prepare_flatten, while updated callers initialize accumulators, but H0 could not call the S0 API successfully in the first place.
recommended_action: Do not attribute maintenance to this commit. Address the pre-existing harness gap separately by passing an initialized h2o_qpack_header_stats_t to h2o_qpack_flatten_request.
